sara (PM): Quick sync: ACME wants tenant opt-in for eval-triggered alerts and a programmatic 'apply recommendation' flow for quantization. Need pilot scope and acceptance gates.

kai (Eng): Proposed split: alert infra (webhook + dashboard) + recs engine (simulate quant profiles). Feature flags from day 1. Canary: internal + 1 alpha tenant.

anika (ML): Signals: concordance_p95, hallucination_rate_top10, latency_p99. Regression = relative change vs 7d baseline. Default threshold = 5%. Quant score formula draft: score = 100*quality_delta - 0.4*latency_improve - 0.3*cost_saving; recommend if score <= 1.5.

miguel (CS): CS needs HMAC-signed webhook payloads and weekly consolidated scorecards. Also must capture tenant consent. Audit trail required for any "Apply" actions.

lina (Design): UX: alert card + recommended quant profile with small explainer and two CTAs: "Propose to tenant" and "Apply (audit)". Keep modal light.

sara (PM): Pilot acceptance (proposal): deploy to internal + 2 alphas; alert precision >= 75% on top-50 prompts; quant recs quality delta <1% in 85% of applied cases; median TTD < 7 days. Pilot = 6 weeks.

kai (Eng): Risks: per-tenant eval storage (~50-200GB/mo). Mitigation: compressed deltas + 30d full traces. Also rate-limit webhook retries.

anika (ML): Action items: publish signal taxonomy, run sims on 6 customers, propose weight tuning by EOW.

miguel (CS): Action: recruit 2 alphas (ACME + 1), capture opt-in.

ops-bot: Feature flag created: ff/eval-alerts-2026 on branch feat/eval-alerts. Staging env provisioned. CI queued. :white_check_mark:

sara (PM): I'll write a one-pager PRD and tag owners. Weekly status updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
